label: Necessarily productive source: it gives something wherever it exists among accessible worlds
definition: NecessarilyGivesSomeAt F w g: at every world accessible from w where g exists, g gives being to some being. The giving-level form of a necessarily operative productive purpose, a categorically directed generative nature, or a maximizer for whom some creation beats omission.
note: Stipulative. It does not fix which being is given (replacement remains possible). See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §61.
